description: Render a QR code for any of six content types: a link, plain text, a v-card contact, a pre-filled email, a phone number, or a pre-filled SMS. The image is returned as a PNG you can look at. Nothing is stored, so this code is STATIC: it encodes the content directly and cannot be changed after it is printed. If the user wants a code they can repoint later, or wants to count scans, create a short link with create_short_link first and then call get_link_qr_code instead. Link and Text work on every plan; V-card, E-mail, Call and SMS require Flyn Pro, as do custom colours and SVG output. WiFi codes contain the network password, so they are made in the Flyn dashboard's QR builder, not through this tool: never ask the user for a WiFi password.

bg.description: Background colour as 6-digit hex, default #FFFFFF. Requires Flyn Pro.

fg.description: Foreground colour as 6-digit hex, default Flyn green #14532D. Requires Flyn Pro.

format.description: Output format: 'png' (default) or 'svg'. SVG requires Flyn Pro.

level.description: Error correction level: 'L', 'M' (default), 'Q' or 'H'. Higher levels survive more damage but make the symbol denser.

margin.description: Quiet zone in modules. Minimum and default is 4, as required by ISO/IEC 18004; smaller values are raised to 4 because a short quiet zone is the most common cause of a printed code failing to scan.

phone.description: For type 'phone': the number to dial. Include the country code, for example +15551234567, or the code only works for people dialling from the same country.

size.description: Maximum width in pixels, 64 to 2048, default 512. The image is the largest whole-module square that fits, so the real width is usually slightly smaller and is reported back.

smsBody.description: For type 'sms': the pre-filled message. The sender still has to press send.

smsPhone.description: For type 'sms': the number to text. Include the country code.

text.description: For type 'text': the plain text to show when scanned.

type.description: What to encode. 'url' and 'text' work on any plan. 'vcard', 'email', 'phone' and 'sms' require Flyn Pro.

url.description: For type 'url': the URL to encode.

vcName.description: For type 'vcard': the person's full name. Required for a v-card.

vcPhone.description: For type 'vcard': phone number. Include the country code, for example +15551234567.

name: create_qr_code
title: Create QR code
